text:
maria: quick heads-up — PR #842 swaps some example wording from 'respond with' to 'generate' in the SDK snippets. not all pages updated and a few microcopy pieces still say 'respond'.
aj: i noticed. my vote: keep API method names as-is (generate, embed, rerank) but user-facing instructions should be in plain english: "get a response" or "create an embedding". avoids leaking method names into prose.
maria: makes sense. the confusion came up in the migration guide where we had both 'call client.generate' and 'ask the model to respond'.
devon: can we be explicit in the style guide? tiny rule: use code identifiers in backticks for API calls (`client.generate(...)`) and plain verbs for user flows ("get a response"). add example pair.
samir: i'll draft a short appendix for the SDK migration doc — include a find/replace snippet and a short regex to catch stray uses. example: `s/\brespond(s|ed)?\b/generate/g` but only when near `client` or `SDK` mentions.
maria: +1. also noticed locale-specific phrasing in a couple pages — UK vs US spelling (behaviour vs behavior) in the examples folder. decide on one?
aj: choose US by default for external docs, but tolerate British spellings in community-contributed guides. add a note in style guide.
devon: small nit: voice for microcopy (buttons, CTAs). Proposal: active, direct, second-person. e.g., 'Generate output' vs 'Generates output'. prefer 'Generate' on buttons.
maria: ok. can we also lock down terminology: prefer 'model variant' over 'model flavor' and 'rollout' over 'deploy' when referring to canary/A-B features?
samir: agreed. i'll add a mini-glossary entry mapping old terms to canonical ones so we can run a repo-wide search.
docs-bot: linting: docs-build / links-check failed on PR #842 — 3 broken links found in docs/sdk/snippets.md (see CI).
maria: i'll patch the broken links in the PR, thanks. devon, can you add the glossary entry in the same PR or a follow-up?
devon: i'll add it as a follow-up in a tiny PR (aiming EOD). will include: canonical term, deprecated aliases, example sentence, and recommended in-prose phrasing.
aj: for examples, let's standardize the snippet layout: short one-liner description, code block with `# language` hint, expected short output. keeps pages scannable.
samir: adding that to the appendix. also: we should include a checklist for reviewers to catch these tone/terminology issues in doc PR template. small checklist items: [ ] API vs prose wording, [ ] locale spelling, [ ] glossary terms, [ ] button CTAs.
maria: perfect. assigning: samir (appendix + checklist), devon (glossary PR), aj (update reviewer template), me (fix links in PR #842).
aj: i'll update the reviewer template today. ping me if you want me to add automated labels (e.g., 'needs-style-check') to PRs.
samir: could we automate a shallow grep that flags banned terms like 'flavor' and suggests 'variant'? happy to throw that into the docs-ci.
devon: yes please — that will save future bikeshedding.
maria: thanks all. i'll post a short update in #docs when PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
